name: IOIPG
recent: IOI Properties 完成以 6.93 亿令吉收购新加坡 Shenton 101，并推进 IOIPG REIT 的首次公开募股，最终发售价定为每单位 0.91 令吉。公司于 11 月 6 日举行第 14 届常年股东大会，所有普通决议案均获通过。执行董事 Dato' Lee Yeow Seng 在闭市期间多次增持公司股份。
notable: 完成以 6.93 亿令吉收购新加坡 Shenton 101 全部股权。
IOIPG REIT 首次公开募股发售价定为每单位 0.91 令吉，公众部分超额认购 0.59 倍。
第 14 届常年股东大会所有普通决议案获股东通过。
risks: IOIPG REIT 的首次公开募股发售价从初始水平下调至每单位 0.91 令吉。
独立非执行董事 Lim Sim Seng 退休。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度，营收为 13.87 亿令吉，环比增长 32.4%，同比增长 55.8%；净利为 5.23 亿令吉，环比增长 102.7%，但同比下降 36.5%；净利率为 37.7%，高于上一季度的 24.6%。

recent_en: IOI Properties completed the RM693 million acquisition of Shenton 101 in Singapore and progressed the IPO of IOIPG REIT, with the final offer price fixed at RM0.91 per unit. The company held its 14th AGM on 6 November, where all ordinary resolutions were passed. Executive Director Dato' Lee Yeow Seng acquired shares multiple times during the closed period.
notable_en: Completed the RM693 million acquisition of the entire equity interest in Shenton 101, Singapore.
IOIPG REIT IPO offer price fixed at RM0.91 per unit, with the public tranche oversubscribed 0.59 times.
All ordinary resolutions were passed by shareholders at the 14th AGM.
risks_en: The IPO offer price for IOIPG REIT was lowered to RM0.91 per unit from the initial level.
Independent Non-Executive Director Lim Sim Seng retired.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM1.387 billion, up 32.4% QoQ and 55.8% YoY; net income was RM523.1 million, up 102.7% QoQ but down 36.5% YoY; net margin was 37.7%, higher than 24.6% in the previous quarter.
